speaker: Perrin
text: There he is. The boy from the road. Half the school's whispering 'commoner,' 'that mark,' 'is it safe' — and here I am grinning, because I already know what you do when it counts. You go.

speaker: Kai
text: That's usually the part people warn me about.

speaker: Perrin
text: The others'll want to cage it or dissect it. Emberwing wants to stand next to it. You don't need managing, Kai. You need people who won't flinch when the light comes up. That's us. That's the whole pitch.

speaker: Perrin
text: Courage, warmth, and a house full of loud idiots who'll walk into fire beside you and mean it. Come be one of the loud idiots.

speaker: Perrin
text: It IS almost good. It's the best thing there is. Say yes.
